page_title: Conduck - Talk to your own personal AI from every Apple device

summary.name: Conduck
summary.one_liner: Conduck is a native Apple client for chatting with your own AI (self-hosted agent, model server, or hosted model via OpenRouter) across iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Watch and CarPlay.
use_cases: chat with a self-hosted AI agent from iPhone or Mac
quick start with a hosted model using an OpenRouter key
collect screenshots, links and files for later AI tasks
continue one conversation across Apple devices
summary.what_it_does: Conduck is a client app: you configure the AI connection yourself (a hosted provider account, a self-hosted agent or OpenAI-style model server, or an OpenRouter key), and Conduck sends your messages to that connection. It supports text, voice (Apple on-device transcription by default), photos, screenshots and files on iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Watch and CarPlay, with conversations synced through the user's private iCloud. The Work desk stores ideas, voice notes, links and files, and nothing is sent to the AI until the user reviews and sends a brief. The page says the app is open source under Apache 2.0 and has no Conduck-operated intermediary server, account, or telemetry.
notable: No Conduck account or Conduck-operated server; API keys stored in Apple Keychain
Work desk: collect materials without sending them to the AI until you review a brief
Open source under Apache 2.0 with a public adapter contract for custom agent harnesses
Private usage stats recorded on-device and in the user's iCloud, never prompts or replies
caveats: Requires iOS, iPadOS, macOS, and watchOS 26.5 or later; Apple-only, Android not available
Conduck Pro is an optional paid subscription (USD 29.99 or EUR 29.99 monthly); free plan limits Work to three active projects and three gateways
Hosted or self-hosted AI costs are paid separately to those providers; the user must supply and manage their own AI connection
